name: Audio Example
author: you
description: A small audio mod: its audio.json adds a bank of self-made chimes as a location set on the format-demo map (random distant chimes every 4-8 s), and its script layers a click on the game's own pop sound and counts pops and landings from the game's audio events. Off by default.

click.label: Click on pops
click.description: Layer a short click on every pop (the game's own pop still plays).
